messages.content: 誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

top.description: Number of top players to return. Default is 5.

message.content:
在爵士樂界，評選「最佳」歌手往往取決於個人品味、歷史影響力以及技術表現。以下列出五位被廣泛認為對爵士歌唱藝術有深遠貢獻且在音樂史上佔據重要地位的歌手（按字母順序排列）：

| 歌手 | 代表作品 / 標誌性風格 | 為何被視為頂尖 |
|------|------------------------|---------------|
| **Billie Holiday** | “Strange Fruit”, “God Bless the Child” | 她的情感真摯、即興靈活，改變了爵士歌唱的語調與節奏。 |
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | “Summertime”, “Dream a Little Dream of Me” | 被譽為“爵士天后”，以無瑕的音準、流暢的即興和多樣化的曲風聞名。 |
| **Sarah Vaughan** | “Misty”, “Lullaby of Birdland” | 她的聲域寬廣、音色柔美，將歌唱技巧提升到新的高度。 |
| **Nina Simone** | “Feeling Good”, “I Put a Spell on You” | 將爵士、藍調、古典融合，並以政治意識強烈的演繹方式著稱。 |
| **Diana Krall** | “The Look of Love”, “All of Me” | 現代爵士女高音，以鋼琴伴奏自成一派，兼具傳統與創新。 |

> **備註**：如果你想了解更多關於某位歌手的生平、專輯或演出資訊，隨時告訴我！
message.reasoning: The user asks "誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？" which means "Who is the best jazz singer?" They want a list of top singers. We can use the function search_music_instrument_players? But that's for instrument players, not singers. There's no function for singers. So we need to answer manually. Provide a list of top jazz singers. Use knowledge up to 2024. Provide maybe 5 names. Also mention criteria. Let's respond.
